tldr: 台股6月11日止穩，加權指數終場僅微跌收43,149點，盤中振幅高達1,456點；被動元件龍頭國巨領漲與尾盤電子買盤回籠，化解外資大舉賣超的壓力。
美股隔夜強勁反彈，川普釋出美伊接近達成協議的訊號，道瓊重返50,000點之上、國際油價同步走緩。
歐洲央行睽違2023年以來首度升息，存款利率調升至2.25%，理由為戰爭推升的能源通膨；美國5月躉售物價也明顯升溫，市場聚焦下週聯準會決議。
台灣財富管理熱度持續集中於ETF；同時金管會推出壽險業暫行措施與IFRS 17接軌規範，協助穩定壽險業體質。
遺贈稅修法持續受關注，擬將被繼承人死亡前兩年內對親屬的贈與併入遺產總額課稅。

items.title_zh: 台股殺尾盤翻紅、振幅1,456點收平盤附近，電子買盤回籠吸收外資賣壓
items.title_en: Taiex ends near-flat after a wild 1,456-point swing as late tech bids absorb foreign selling
items.summary_zh: 加權指數6月11日終場收43,149.46點，僅微跌76.08點（-0.18%），成交值約1.26兆元；盤中一度重挫逾1,219點，為史上第8大盤中跌點。指數在1,456點的劇烈區間來回震盪後，靠台積電守穩平盤，加上聯電、華邦電、南亞科等電子股買盤回籠，才將跌幅大幅收斂。前一夜美股因5月CPI攀至三年新高的4.2%而四大指數同步收黑，拖累亞股開盤risk sentiment轉弱，台股早盤一度急殺、午後才止穩。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex closed June 11 at 43,149.46, down just 76.08 points (-0.18%) on turnover of about NT$1.26 trillion, after a brutal session that at one point plunged more than 1,219 points — the eighth-largest intraday drop on record. The index whipsawed across a 1,456-point range before a steadying bid in TSMC, UMC, Winbond, Nanya Tech and other electronics names dragged it back toward the flat line. The session followed an overnight slide on Wall Street, where U.S. May CPI hit a three-year high of 4.2% and the major indices closed lower, pressuring Asian risk sentiment at the open.

items.title_zh: 被動元件領漲、國巨除息前翻紅撐盤
items.title_en: Passive components lead the tape as Yageo holds up before ex-dividend
items.summary_zh: 6月11日被動元件成為盤面最亮眼族群，但呈兩樣情：大毅、日電貿等約6檔亮燈漲停，雷科等少數個股一度觸及跌停，顯示族群內資金輪動快速、強弱分化擴大。龍頭國巨在除息前夕翻紅，盤中最高來到861元附近、終場約收842元（+2.81%）；若以盤中高點計，今年以來漲幅一度達約272%，續扮族群指標。法人提醒，強勢股與弱勢股差距拉大，投資人不宜純以題材追價，仍須留意基本面、籌碼面與短線漲多後的震盪風險。
items.summary_en: Passive-component stocks were the standout group on June 11 but showed a sharp split: about six names including Ta-I and Jih-Lin hit limit-up, while a handful such as LeaTec briefly touched limit-down, underscoring fast money rotation within the cluster. Group bellwether Yageo turned green ahead of its ex-dividend date, with the shares reaching an intraday high near NT$861 and closing around NT$842 (+2.81%); on the intraday high the stock's year-to-date gain stretched to roughly 272%. Analysts cautioned that the widening gap between strong and weak names means investors should weigh fundamentals and chip-flow rather than chase the theme alone.

items.title_zh: 外資賣壓縮減、投信連買撐盤，後市緊盯月線與費半
items.title_en: Foreign selling eases as domestic funds keep buying; market eyes monthly line and SOX
items.summary_zh: 6月11日三大法人賣超縮減至353.91億元，其中外資及陸資（不含外資自營商）賣超357.79億元，較先前單日動輒賣超數百億明顯收斂；投信續站買方、買超127.88億元，提供內資支撐。在外資仍偏賣方下，法人指出短線觀察重點在指數能否站回月線，以及費城半導體指數走勢——台灣大型電子權值股與美國晶片股情緒高度連動，費半方向將牽動台股後續強弱。
items.summary_en: Net selling by the three major institutional investors narrowed to NT$35.39 billion on June 11, with foreign and mainland investors (excluding foreign proprietary desks) offloading NT$35.78 billion — a clear moderation from earlier sessions when overseas funds had dumped far larger sums. Investment trusts stayed on the buy side, adding NT$12.79 billion and providing a domestic cushion. With foreign players still net sellers, strategists said the near-term focus is whether the index can reclaim its monthly moving average and how the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index behaves, given how tightly Taiwan's large-cap tech names track U.S. chip sentiment.

items.title_zh: 台積電2026 AI動能撐起晶片供應鏈，大摩估AI半導體需求年增約70%
items.title_en: TSMC's 2026 AI momentum underpins the chip supply chain; Morgan Stanley sees AI semis up ~70%
items.summary_zh: 近期市場聚焦台積電，先進製程銷售占整體晶圓營收約74%，公司並指引2026全年美元營收成長逾30%，反映AI需求強勁。摩根士丹利最新報告預估2026年AI半導體需求年增約70%，點名台積電與散熱、記憶體等族群為主要受惠者。台積電2026年資本支出規模估達約520～560億美元，龐大投資可望外溢至整體供應鏈，帶動設備、先進封裝與高效能運算（HPC）相關廠商，鞏固台灣電子業在AI浪潮中的核心地位，也成為法人布局產業時的主軸題材。
items.summary_en: Recent commentary around TSMC pointed to advanced-node sales making up about 74% of total wafer revenue, with the foundry guiding to full-year 2026 USD revenue growth of more than 30% on relentless AI demand. Morgan Stanley's latest read on 2026 AI semiconductors projected industry demand rising around 70% year-on-year, naming TSMC alongside thermal-management and memory plays among the key beneficiaries. TSMC's heavy 2026 capex plan — estimated at roughly US$52–56 billion — is expected to ripple through the broader supply chain, supporting equipment, advanced packaging and high-performance computing vendors across Taiwan's electronics complex.

items.title_zh: 台商海外投資首季暴增至3,627億元創高，AI三雄撐起獲利
items.title_en: Taiwan firms' overseas investment surges to a record NT$362.7bn in Q1, with the "AI three" anchoring profits
items.summary_zh: 台商首季對外投資衝上歷史新高，達3,627億元，主因業者為服務AI與高效能運算需求、並分散供應鏈風險而擴大海外布局。期間獲利成長主要由台灣指標性的AI權值龍頭撐起，顯示企業獲利動能高度集中於人工智慧建置題材。數據同時反映台灣企業部門愈來愈依賴單一長線主軸的機會與風險，也解釋了為何外資對台灣電子權值股的資金進出，會隨全球AI情緒而大幅擺盪，成為觀察產業景氣與台股結構的重要訊號。
items.summary_en: Outbound investment by Taiwanese companies jumped to a record in the first quarter, reported at NT$362.7 billion, as manufacturers expand capacity abroad to serve AI and high-performance computing demand and to diversify supply chains. Profit growth across the period was anchored by Taiwan's leading AI-linked heavyweights, reflecting how concentrated earnings momentum has become around the artificial-intelligence build-out. The data highlight both the opportunity and the risk of a Taiwan corporate sector increasingly tied to a single secular theme, and reinforce why foreign-investor flows into the island's tech names swing so sharply with global AI sentiment.

items.title_zh: Google逾兆元AI投資點名台灣供應鏈贏家
items.title_en: Google's multi-trillion AI spending spree spotlights Taiwan supply-chain winners
items.summary_zh: 美系雲端巨頭對AI基礎建設的龐大資本支出（市場報導Google相關投資達數兆元新台幣規模），再度將焦點拉回台灣硬體供應鏈。外媒點名包含台積電在內的最大受惠族群，凸顯雲端業者資本支出直接轉化為對台灣晶圓代工、伺服器、網通與散熱方案廠的訂單動能。此題材強化台灣電子出口商的結構性需求敘事；但在AI股大漲一段後，投資人也須評估市場樂觀預期有多少已反映在偏高的評價，慎防追高震盪風險。
items.summary_en: Heavy capital commitments to AI infrastructure by U.S. hyperscalers, including a Google build-out reported in the trillions of NT dollars, have put a renewed spotlight on Taiwan's hardware supply chain. Foreign commentators flagged a short list of biggest beneficiaries, with TSMC among the names cited, underscoring how cloud-provider capex translates directly into orders for Taiwan's foundry, server, networking and thermal-solution makers. The theme reinforces the structural demand narrative behind Taiwan's electronics exporters, even as investors weigh how much of the optimism is already priced into richly valued AI-linked shares after a strong run.

items.title_zh: 金管會推壽險業暫行措施，穩定市場波動衝擊
items.title_en: FSC rolls out interim measures to steady life insurers through market volatility
items.summary_zh: 金管會針對壽險業推出暫行措施，緩解近期國際金融市場與資本市場劇烈波動的衝擊，協助業者在2026年順利接軌IFRS 17與新一代清償能力制度（ICS）。措施目的在於平滑準備金「以市價評價」的轉換過程，並在利率與匯率動盪期間管理壽險業資產負債表的波動。透過減輕轉換期的壓力點，主管機關力求維持業者資本適足率穩定、避免無序去風險（de-risking）。此舉顯示金管會對攸關台灣長期儲蓄與債券市場的壽險業，持續採取積極監理態度，後續配套與業者因應動向值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission introduced interim measures for the life-insurance sector to cushion the impact of recent international financial-market swings and capital-market fluctuations as insurers transition in 2026 to IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency (ICS) regime. The measures are designed to smooth the shift to market-consistent valuation of reserves and to manage volatility in insurers' balance sheets during a period of rate and currency turbulence. By easing transitional pressure points, the regulator aims to keep capital ratios stable and avoid disorderly de-risking, signalling continued hands-on oversight of an industry central to Taiwan's long-term savings and bond markets.

items.title_zh: 壽險業倒數接軌IFRS 17／ICS 2.0，金管會微調揭露規範
items.title_en: Insurers count down to IFRS 17 / ICS 2.0 as the FSC tunes disclosure rules
items.summary_zh: 台灣保險業2026年正式接軌IFRS 17與新一代清償能力制度，這項早經預告的重大變革，將更清楚反映每張保單對獲利的貢獻度與業者體質。為因應保險收入認列流程更趨複雜，金管會放寬保險業及具保險業子公司之公開發行公司營收公告期限，由每月10日延至15日，並修正財務報告編製準則、增訂「保險服務結果對稅前純益比率」等指標。IFRS 17下，未實現利潤在保單到期前列為負債，於提供保險服務期間逐期認列為收入；改以市場利率評價準備金後，業者須提列更多準備金，對壽險獲利與資本將帶來結構性影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's insurance sector formally adopts IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency framework in 2026, a long-telegraphed shift that better reflects each policy's contribution to profit and the underlying health of insurers. To ease the more complex revenue-recognition process, the FSC has moved to relax monthly revenue-disclosure deadlines for insurers and insurance-holding companies — pushing the filing date from the 10th to the 15th — and amended financial-reporting standards to add metrics such as the ratio of insurance-service results to pre-tax profit. Under IFRS 17, unrealised profit is held as a liability until earned over the service period, and market-rate reserve valuation will require insurers to set aside more reserves.

items.title_zh: 2026年ETF仍是台灣零售理財配置核心
items.title_en: ETFs remain the core of Taiwan's retail wealth playbook in 2026
items.summary_zh: 在震盪的2026年市場中，ETF依舊是台灣「定期定額／存股族」的首選配置基石，高股息與市值型產品主導了定期定額資金。最多人定期定額的標的包括元大台灣50（0050）及00919、00878等高息ETF，顯示在波動環境下，投資人偏好分散、重收益的配置更勝單一個股。對財富管理業者而言，ETF需求的韌性支撐了手續費收入與管理資產規模（AUM）；即便客戶會依利率預期與AI主導的股市強弱，在高息型與市值型產品間輪動，整體ETF資金黏著度仍是財管業務的重要動能來源。
items.summary_en: Through the choppy 2026 market, ETFs have stayed the default building block for Taiwan's "stock-saving" (定期定額) investors, with high-dividend and market-cap products dominating regular-savings flows. Among the most popular names cited for systematic investment are Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050) and high-yield products such as 00919 and 00878, reflecting a continued preference for diversified, income-oriented exposure over single stocks amid volatility. For wealth managers, the durability of ETF demand underpins fee income and assets under management, even as clients rotate between dividend-focused and broad-market vehicles depending on rate expectations and the strength of the AI-led equity rally.

items.title_zh: 私人銀行門檻凸顯高資產客戶爭奪戰
items.title_en: Private banking thresholds underline the race for high-net-worth clients
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產與超高資產客戶的競爭依舊激烈，約有9家銀行——含匯豐、星展、渣打等外商，以及國泰、富邦、中信、玉山、永豐、台新等本土銀行——在財富管理門檻與優惠上互別苗頭。在頂端市場，星展頂級私人客戶（DBS Treasures Private Client）要求月均總資產約達新台幣1億元，涵蓋存款餘額、各投資商品現值及累計保費。各家以分級門檻、跨轉跨提與換匯免費、海外匯款與聯貸等跨境服務布局，凸顯銀行如何環繞信託、結構型商品、基金與保險，搶攻台灣日益擴大的富裕家庭客群與其錢包占有率（wallet share）。
items.summary_en: Competition for Taiwan's high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients remains intense, with roughly nine banks — including foreign players HSBC, DBS and Standard Chartered alongside domestic names such as Cathay, Fubon, CTBC, E.SUN, SinoPac and Taishin — vying on wealth-management thresholds and perks. At the top end, DBS Treasures Private Client requires monthly average total assets of around NT$100 million, spanning deposits, investment products and accumulated insurance premiums. The tiered structures, fee waivers and cross-border services on offer highlight how banks are positioning around trusts, structured products, funds and insurance to capture wallet share from Taiwan's expanding pool of affluent households.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法擬將死亡前贈與併回遺產課稅
items.title_en: Estate- and gift-tax reform would pull pre-death gifts back into the taxable estate
items.summary_zh: 財政部預告修正《遺產及贈與稅法》，調整「擬制遺產」課稅邏輯：被繼承人死亡前兩年內贈與親屬的財產，將併入遺產總額課稅，並由受贈人單獨負擔該部分遺產稅。此修正鎖定「臨終前移轉資產以壓縮遺產總額」的常見規劃手法，收緊對晚期贈與的課稅認定。對高資產家庭及顧問而言，若三讀通過，將迫使傳承規劃須提早、更審慎地進行，而非臨時抱佛腳式贈與，並牽動信託、保單與贈與等傳承架構的設計方式，是財富傳承實務近期最須密切追蹤的稅務變數之一。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance has floated amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act that reshape the "deemed estate" rules: property gifted to relatives within two years before death would be folded back into the total taxable estate, with the recipient (donee) bearing the resulting estate tax. The proposal targets a common succession-planning tactic of transferring assets shortly before death to shrink the taxable estate, and would tighten how late-stage gifts are treated. For high-net-worth families and their advisers, the change — if enacted — would force earlier, more deliberate wealth-transfer planning rather than last-minute gifting, and reshape trust, insurance and gifting structures used in succession design.

items.title_zh: 2026年贈與稅免稅額維持244萬元，雙親合計488萬元
items.title_en: 2026 gift-tax allowance stays at NT$2.44m per parent — NT$4.88m combined
items.summary_zh: 2026年台灣每人每年贈與稅免稅額維持244萬元，意即父母各自擁有244萬元額度，一年合計可免稅贈與子女達488萬元。免稅額是家族財富移轉的核心工具，讓父母得以在免稅門檻內有系統地將資產移轉給下一代，超過部分則適用累進贈與稅率。實務上，顧問常將年度免稅額與較長期的工具（信託、保單、分年贈與）搭配運用，以更有效率地完成資產傳承。在前述「擬制遺產」可能收緊的修法背景下，善用年度免稅額、提早分年贈與的規劃急迫性更為提高，值得高資產家庭及早布局。
items.summary_en: For 2026, Taiwan's annual gift-tax exemption remains at NT$2.44 million per donor, meaning each parent holds a separate NT$2.44 million allowance and a couple can together gift up to NT$4.88 million tax-free to children each year. The allowance is a core lever in family wealth transfer, letting parents systematically shift assets to the next generation within the exempt threshold while keeping gifts above it subject to progressive gift-tax brackets. Advisers typically pair the annual exemption with longer-horizon tools — trusts, insurance and staggered gifting — to move wealth efficiently, a planning calculus that gains urgency alongside the proposed tightening of deemed-estate rules.

items.title_zh: 財政部與國稅局6月密集提醒：都更權利變換課稅與退稅詐騙
items.title_en: MOF and tax bureaus issue June reminders on urban-renewal taxation and refund scams
items.summary_zh: 台灣稅務機關6月發布多則提醒。財政部6月11日公告個人參與「權利變換」都市更新案的課稅規定，釐清經由都更取得房地的課稅處理；各區國稅局並提醒，絕不會以電子郵件通知退稅，藉此防範釣魚詐騙；財政部南區國稅局6月10日則公告，原免課遺產稅或贈與稅的農業用地日後出售時，應補繳相關稅款的規定。這些公告凸顯主管機關在例行宣導中，持續聚焦不動產相關交易課稅與納稅人防詐，提醒民眾留意都更、農地等情境的稅務細節，避免日後遭補稅與裁罰。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's tax authorities rolled out a cluster of June notices. The Ministry of Finance on June 11 published guidance on taxation of individuals participating in rights-transformation urban-renewal cases, clarifying the treatment of property received through such schemes. National tax bureaus separately reminded taxpayers that they will never notify refunds by email — a warning aimed at phishing scams — while the Southern Region bureau on June 10 issued guidance on back-taxes due when farmland that was exempt from estate or gift tax is later sold. The notices underscore the authorities' ongoing focus on real-estate-linked transactions and taxpayer fraud-prevention in routine compliance communications.

items.title_zh: 歐洲央行睽違2023年首度升息，存款利率升至2.25%對抗戰爭通膨
items.title_en: ECB delivers its first hike since 2023, lifting the deposit rate to 2.25% on war-driven inflation
items.summary_zh: 歐洲央行6月11日近三年來首度升息，存款利率調升至2.25%、再融資利率升至2.40%，為市場廣泛預期之舉，目的在對抗與伊朗戰爭相關的能源型通膨。總裁拉加德指出，中東衝突正持續推升物價壓力，整體通膨升至3.2%、為2023年以來最高，5月核心通膨亦升至2.5%，顯示壓力不僅限於能源。此決策正值歐元區經濟首季萎縮0.2%、引發停滯性通膨（stagflation）疑慮之際；歐洲央行同步將2026年成長預估下修至0.8%，凸顯升息與衰退風險並存的政策兩難，對全球資金與匯率走向影響深遠。
items.summary_en: The European Central Bank raised rates for the first time in nearly three years on June 11, lifting the deposit rate to 2.25% and the refinancing rate to 2.40% in a widely anticipated move to counter energy-driven inflation tied to the Iran war. President Christine Lagarde flagged that the Middle East conflict is generating price pressures, with headline inflation up to 3.2% — the highest since 2023 — and core inflation rising to 2.5% in May. The decision came as the eurozone economy shrank 0.2% in Q1, prompting stagflation warnings; the ECB cut its 2026 growth projection to 0.8%.

items.title_zh: 美國躉售物價升溫，為下週Fed、日銀、英央行決議揭開序幕
items.title_en: Hot U.S. wholesale prices set the stage for next week's Fed, BOJ and BOE meetings
items.summary_zh: 在央行決策週前，美國通膨數據明顯升溫。5月生產者物價（PPI）跳升，整體月增1.1%、核心月增0.4%，年增率升至約6.5%，為2022年底以來最快的躉售通膨步調；另一項數據則顯示5月CPI達三年新高的4.2%。數據使聯準會、日本央行與英格蘭銀行（均於下週開會）的政策路徑更為複雜——中東衝突推升的能源型通膨，與成長放緩跡象相互拉扯。市場正評估，黏著的通膨是否將迫使聯準會採取更偏鷹派的「按兵不動」，相關決議與利率點陣圖將牽動全球股債與匯市方向。
items.summary_en: U.S. inflation data ran hot heading into a packed central-bank week. May producer prices jumped, with headline PPI up 1.1% and core PPI up 0.4%, lifting the annual PPI rate to about 6.5% — the fastest pace of wholesale inflation since late 2022 — while a separate reading put May CPI at a three-year-high 4.2%. The figures complicate the policy path for the Federal Reserve, Bank of Japan and Bank of England, all of which meet next week, as energy-driven price pressures from the Middle East conflict collide with signs of slowing growth. Markets are weighing whether sticky inflation forces a more hawkish hold.

items.title_zh: 美伊降溫激勵風險偏好，美股反彈、道瓊重返50,000點
items.title_en: Wall Street rebounds as U.S.–Iran de-escalation lifts risk appetite, Dow reclaims 50,000
items.summary_zh: 美股6月11日強勁反彈，川普喊停對伊朗的攻擊計畫並釋出可能很快達成協議的訊號，化解前一日重創市場的地緣政治風險溢價。那斯達克指數大漲約2.5%、標普500上漲約1.8%，道瓊勁揚約930點、重返50,000點之上，由科技、工業與原物料類股領漲。這波「鬆一口氣」的反彈，扭轉前一交易日的跌勢，也為亞股提供正向的隔夜指引——這正是台股當日能從早盤急殺中收斂跌幅、翻紅止穩的關鍵外部因素之一。
items.summary_en: U.S. equities staged a sharp rebound on June 11 after President Trump called off planned strikes on Iran and signalled a deal could come soon, easing the geopolitical risk premium that had battered markets a day earlier. The Nasdaq jumped about 2.5%, the S&P 500 rose roughly 1.8% and the Dow surged some 930 points to reclaim the 50,000 mark, led by technology, industrials and materials. The relief rally reversed the prior session's slump and offered a constructive overnight lead for Asian markets — a key reason Taiwan's Taiex was able to claw back from a steep early drop.

items.title_zh: 油價守在每桶93美元下方，荷莫茲海峽流量抵消攻擊疑慮
items.title_en: Oil holds below US$93 as Hormuz flows offset strike fears
items.summary_zh: 國際油價6月11日在漲跌間擺盪，布蘭特原油徘徊每桶約92美元；美伊再起衝突的疑慮降溫，與荷莫茲海峽運量上升的訊號相互抵消。川普警告可能對伊朗能源基礎設施發動更多攻擊，但阿聯與伊朗罕見直接對話、燃起降溫希望。由於石油設施大致未受波及，市場原先擔憂的供應衝擊並未發生，油價維持在先前衝突高點之下，對包括台灣在內的能源進口國是一大紓解，也成為左右全球通膨預期的重要變數，後續中東談判進展仍須密切追蹤。
items.summary_en: Crude prices swung between gains and losses on June 11, with Brent trading near US$92 a barrel as easing fears of renewed U.S.–Iran clashes were balanced against signs of rising flows through the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump warned of possible further strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure, even as the UAE and Iran held rare direct talks that raised hopes of de-escalation. With oil facilities largely spared, the feared supply shock has not materialised, keeping prices well below earlier conflict peaks — a relief for energy importers including Taiwan and a key swing factor for global inflation expectations.

items.title_zh: 川普喊停伊朗攻擊、美股反彈，道瓊重返50,000點上方（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: U.S. stocks rally on Trump–Iran de-escalation as Dow jumps back above 50,000 (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: 美股週四強勁反彈，川普喊停對伊朗的軍事打擊，並釋出可能很快達成協議的明確訊號。那斯達克漲約2.54%、標普500漲約1.75%，道瓊勁揚近930點至約50,848點，由科技、工業與原物料類股領漲，油價也因情勢降溫而走緩，市場風險偏好明顯回升。
items.summary_en: Wall Street rebounded sharply Thursday after President Trump called off strikes on Iran and gave the clearest signal yet that a deal could arrive soon. The Nasdaq rose about 2.54%, the S&P 500 gained roughly 1.75% and the Dow surged nearly 930 points to around 50,848, led by tech, industrials and materials as oil eased on the de-escalation.

items.title_zh: 美國5月躉售物價升溫，創2022年底以來最快（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: U.S. May wholesale prices run hot, fastest since late 2022 (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: 美國5月生產者物價高於預期，整體PPI月增1.1%、核心PPI月增0.4%，年增率升至約6.5%，高於市場預估的6.4%。躉售物價目前以2022年底以來最快速度上升，在下週聯準會決議前，使通膨前景更趨複雜，市場對政策路徑的解讀也更為審慎。
items.summary_en: May producer prices came in above expectations, with headline PPI up 1.1% and core PPI up 0.4%, lifting the annual rate to about 6.5% versus a 6.4% consensus. Wholesale prices are now rising at their fastest pace since late 2022, complicating the inflation outlook just days before the Federal Reserve's policy meeting next week.

items.title_zh: 歐洲央行睽違2023年首度升息，伊朗戰爭推升能源成本（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: ECB hikes for the first time since 2023 as Iran war ramps up energy costs (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: 歐洲央行近三年來首度升息，存款利率升至2.25%、再融資利率升至2.40%。總裁拉加德點出戰爭驅動的通膨，整體通膨升至2023年以來最高的3.2%、核心通膨2.5%。在歐元區首季經濟萎縮0.2%下，歐洲央行同步將2026年成長預估下修至0.8%，凸顯停滯性通膨風險。
items.summary_en: The European Central Bank raised rates for the first time in nearly three years, lifting its deposit rate to 2.25% and refinancing rate to 2.40%. President Lagarde cited war-driven inflation, with headline inflation at a 2023-high 3.2% and core at 2.5%. The ECB cut its 2026 growth forecast to 0.8% as the eurozone economy contracted 0.2% in Q1.

items.title_zh: SpaceX以每股135美元定價登陸那斯達克，估值約1.77兆美元（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: SpaceX prices IPO at $135 a share for a Nasdaq debut, valued near $1.77 trillion (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: SpaceX將首次公開發行價格定為每股135美元，將以代號「SPCX」登陸那斯達克，計畫出售約5.556億股、募資約750億美元，可望成為史上最大IPO。以此定價，公司估值約1.77兆美元，高於特斯拉；馬斯克將保有逾82%投票權，高盛擔任主辦承銷商，市場高度關注其掛牌後表現。
items.summary_en: SpaceX set a fixed IPO price of $135 per share ahead of a Nasdaq debut under the ticker "SPCX," planning to sell about 555.6 million shares to raise roughly $75 billion — set to be the biggest IPO ever. At that price the company would be valued near $1.77 trillion, above Tesla, with Elon Musk retaining over 82% voting control and Goldman Sachs leading the offering.

items.title_en: Oil swings below $93 as Hormuz flows offset renewed strike fears (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: 布蘭特原油週四徘徊每桶約92美元，美伊再衝突疑慮降溫，與荷莫茲海峽油輪運量增加相互抵消。川普警告可能對伊朗能源設施發動更多攻擊，阿聯與伊朗罕見直接對話則燃起降溫希望；由於石油設施大致未受波及，油價維持在先前衝突高點之下。
items.summary_en: Brent traded near $92 a barrel Thursday as easing fears of fresh U.S.–Iran clashes were offset by rising tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Trump warned of possible further strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure, while rare direct UAE–Iran talks raised de-escalation hopes; oil facilities have largely been spared, keeping prices well below earlier conflict peaks.

items.title_zh: 美國10年期公債殖利率約4.54%，標售買盤強勁（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield near 4.54% after strong auction (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: 美國10年期公債殖利率週四盤初約4.54%，在週三10年期公債標售吸引2026年以來最佳需求後維持平穩。穩健的標售買盤顯示，即便通膨數據升溫，市場對美國公債的胃納仍佳；此一指標為下週聯準會決議前，全球利率與股市評價的重要參考。
items.summary_en: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield traded near 4.54% early Thursday, holding steady after Wednesday's 10-year note auction drew the best demand metrics of 2026. Solid auction demand pointed to continued appetite for U.S. government debt even with inflation data running hot, a key reference for global rates and equity valuations ahead of next week's Fed meeting.

items.title_zh: 前一日美股因伊朗攻擊疑慮與CPI升溫重挫（2026-06-10／背景）
items.title_en: Stocks had slumped the prior day as Iran-strike fears and hot CPI hit risk assets (2026-06-10) — context
items.summary_zh: 美股6月10日大幅下跌，道瓊重挫約900點，美國釋出可能對伊朗發動更多攻擊的訊號，加上5月CPI升至三年新高，打擊市場情緒。這場避險走勢，為次日在降溫訊號出現後的反彈鋪路，顯示股市目前高度隨中東衝突與通膨路徑而擺盪。
items.summary_en: Markets fell sharply on June 10, with the Dow dropping about 900 points after the U.S. signalled possible further strikes in Iran and a three-year-high May CPI reading rattled sentiment. The risk-off session set up the next day's rebound once de-escalation signals emerged, illustrating how tightly equities are trading around the Middle East conflict and the inflation path.
